scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Asian drama, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Supports movies, TV episodes, direct MP4 or HLS streams, playback headers and available KissKH subtitle tracks.

scrapers.name: OneTouchTV
scrapers.description: Asian drama, anime, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Supports movies and TV episodes through the OneTouchTV encrypted API, including direct stream sources, playback headers and available subtitle tracks.

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: Movie and TV streams from the current MovieBox H5 web API mirror pool
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Nuvio H5 resolver is now the primary MovieBox path. It resolves TMDB metadata, searches MovieBox mirrors, merges unique streams from every successful H5 mirror, preserves each stream's originating playback Referer, merges EN/MS/ID captions, and falls back to native WebView only when H5 yields no playable source.

scrapers.name: PencuriMovie
scrapers.description: Malaysia and Indonesia movie and TV streams with multi-server playback
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Native WebView playback headers are sanitised for Media3 playback while keeping Cookie and the exact player-mirror Referer. Direct media captures are preferred over intermediate /sora/ URLs.

scrapers.name: MSM21
scrapers.description: Malay subtitle movie and TV streams using Zeta player multi-server extraction
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Nuvio MSM21 now evaluates every Zeta player option instead of hard-capping 8 fast + 6 fallback sources. Standard extractors are collected with bounded concurrency and merged/deduplicated; only the expensive native WebView lane remains capped to 3 unresolved mirrors. Multiple mirrors and subtitles can contribute to the final result instead of first-success discarding the rest.

scrapers.name: CineMode
scrapers.description: Movie and TV stream resolver for the CineMode streaming PWA
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Final CineMode resolver. Does not guess internal CineMode routes. Loads the homepage, obtains the TMDB title, drives CineMode search UI, opens the matching title, interacts with Watch/Play/Skip/Close controls, and captures native WebView media requests. Requires VUEO Search Fix 5.
